name: railway_get_project
description: Get one project's services and environments by project `id`. Returns { project { id name services { edges { node { id name } } } environments { edges { node { id name } } } } }. This is how you LIST SERVICES: each service node `id` is the `serviceId`, and each environment node `id` is the `environmentId` — you need both (plus the projectId) to add or read a custom domain. Requires `id` (the project id from railway_list_projects).

body_defaults.query: query project($id: String!) { project(id: $id) { id name services { edges { node { id name } } } environments { edges { node { id name } } } } }
